Their father's death act counts *** NUEVE HIJOS *** and names them, and the third name on the list belongs to nobody the index has found: *** it reads ELEIZA or ELOIZA and this archive cannot choose between them. *** Read at three times magnification before being written down. *** A SEARCH FOR HER UNDER ELOISA WAS RUN AND PROVED NOTHING: *** the query returned a count with rows that ignore the forename, which is the FamilySearch personas behaviour this archive has documented elsewhere and refuses to draw a null from. *** THE TEST: *** the Uruguayan civil birth registrations of the Departamento de San Jose between 1879 and 1898, read for a daughter of this couple who is not one of the eight - most likely in the gap between Zelmira Carlota, 4 November 1880, and Alberto Julian, 17 August 1883.

name: Maria Adelina LERENA Traibel (de FEIN)
source: Nuestra Senora del Carmen, el Cordon, Montevideo - libro 7o de Bautismos, read in the 1896 certified copy made under the Ley de 9 de Julio de 1888 - IMAGE READ; film 008166435 image 02852 pagina 379; and Montevideo civil death registration No. 48, 20 November 1946 - index read 21 September 2026; ark 1:1:XS6K-QJ6F
note: *** THE NINTH CHILD OF AVELINO AND AMBROSIA, found 21 September 2026. *** Her Montevideo death registration of 20 November 1946, certificate 48, names her father AVELINO LERENA and her mother AMBROSIA TRAIBEL, her husband *** CARLOS ALBERTO FEIN *** and a son *** JORGE FEIN ***. *** THE BIRTH YEAR IN THIS COLUMN IS NOT A FINDING. *** The registration gives her birth as 1861 and her birthplace as Montevideo; the family chart gives 1865-1946. *** THE 1861 CANNOT EASILY BE RIGHT, and what rules it out is her own brother. *** Juan Arturo was born 16 February 1861 on his baptismal act, so a sister born in 1861 would have to have been born in the last six weeks of it. The year on a death registration is age-derived and is the weaker of the two, so c.1865 is entered and flagged. *** WHAT WOULD SETTLE IT: *** her own baptism, which has not been looked for.  *** THE BIRTH YEAR IS NO LONGER A GUESS, 21 September 2026: SHE WAS BORN 13 AUGUST 1865. *** Her own baptismal act was found on the second opening of the same certificate book and read: 'En treinta y uno de Diciembre de mil ochocientos sesenta y cinco. El Canonigo Dn. Juan Jose Brid, bautizo solemnemente a MARIA ADELINA, NACIDA EL TRECE DE AGOSTO ULTIMO, hija legitima de Dn. Avelino Lerena y de Da. Ambrosia Traibel, Orientales. Padrinos Dn. AMBROSIO LERENA y Da. CARLOTA MUNOZ.' *** So the 1861 on her death registration is wrong by four years, and the reasoning that flagged it was right for the right reason *** - her brother Juan Arturo was born in February 1861 and no sister could be. *** AND A SECOND RECORD OF HER IS THE SAME ACT. *** FamilySearch also indexes a 'MARTA ADELINA, born 13 August 1918, christened Montevideo 9 May 1919', with godparents Ambrosio Lorena and Carlota Munoz - the same two names and the same 13 August. It is this baptism certified a second time, on a different film, and dated by the index to that certificate. *** One act, two films, and two index entries fifty-three years apart. ***

name: Mercedes Micaela LERENA Traibel

Her godparents were ADOLFO DE LAPUENTE and *** MERCEDES MENDEZ DE LA FUENTE, for whom she is named ***, which is this family's habit four times over. *** SHE IS THE BEST CANDIDATE FOR THE MERCEDES LERENA WHO STOOD GODMOTHER AT THE UNION IN MARCH 1880 *** to her sister Josefa's daughter - who was in turn named Maria de las Mercedes for her. MARQUEZ at the Catedral on 9 July 1883 ***, identified there as this woman - and an unmarried Mercedes Lerena in 1880 is what that marriage date requires. *** INDEX-LEVEL: the image of her christening has not been opened. ***  *** NO LONGER INDEX-LEVEL, 21 September 2026 - THE ACT ITSELF WAS FOUND AND READ. *** Her certificate is No. 147 in the same 1896 book that holds six of her brothers and sisters: 'ella a MERCEDES MICAELA, QUE NACIO EL OCHO DE MAYO DEL ANO MIL OCHOCIENTOS SESENTA Y TRES, hija legitima de Dn. name: Pedro Alberto Ysabelino LERENA Traibel (the ALBERTO of 1852-1921)
source: Vice Parroquia de Nuestra Senora del Carmen, la Aguada, Montevideo - baptism of 21 Nov 1852, libro 1o de Bautismos folio 135, read in the CERTIFIED COPY issued in 1896 - IMAGE READ at full resolution 21 Sep 2026; film 008166435 image 02850, image ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS2C-2SSK-G; index ark 1:1:6DXB-SSGW; and Montevideo civil death registration No. 246, 1 March 1921 - IMAGE READ 21 September 2026; film 008165205 image 01604, image ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS2C-26FM, index ark 1:1:6LD5-X4PR
note: *** A SON OF AVELINO LERENA AND AMBROSIA TRAIBEL THIS ARCHIVE HAD SEEN AND NEVER DATED, 21 September 2026. *** The 14 September working log already listed 'Pedro Alberto Isabelino' among the Lerena Traibel, off the index, and left him there. *** THE INDEX SAYS HE WAS BORN IN 1896, WHICH IS SIX YEARS AFTER HIS FATHER DIED. *** The act itself says otherwise: 'El veinte y uno de Noviembre de 1852 ... bautice solemnemente a PEDRO ALBERTO YSABELINO, que nacio el diez y seis de Marzo del mismo ano, a las once y media del dia, hijo legitimo de AVELINO LERENA y de AMBROSIA TRAIBEL'. *** He was born 16 MARCH 1852 and baptised at eight months. *** What the index dated 1896 is the CERTIFIED COPY, issued that year from libro 1o de Bautismos folio 135. *** HIS GODFATHER WAS HIS UNCLE: PEDRO ANT.o LERENA, with VICENTA VEGA *** - and the boy is named for him, as YSABELINO is for his grandmother Ysabel Centeno. Grandparents on the act: Sancho Lerena and Maria Fernandez, Juan Traibel and Ysabel Centeno. *** AND HE IS THE ALBERTO LERENA OF THE 1921 DEATH REGISTRATION *** - Montevideo, died 1 March 1921, certificate 246, father Avelino Lerena, mother Ambrosia Treibel, wife MARIA INES LARRIERA. That registration gives his age as 69 against a birth of 16 March 1852, which makes him 68 by three weeks; an age at death is the weakest field on any certificate and the identification does not rest on it. *** THE IDENTIFICATION IS AN INFERENCE, NOT AN ACT: *** no record read here writes 'Pedro Alberto Ysabelino' and 'Alberto' on the same page. What joins them is the parents, the year and the name. See data/1852-aguada-union-certificates.tsv.  *** AND HE HAD EIGHT CHILDREN, IN A DEPARTMENT THIS BRANCH WAS NEVER KNOWN TO REACH - found 21 September 2026 by asking for him and his wife as a PAIR. *** Alberto Lerena with Maria Ines Larriera returns sixteen Uruguayan records, and they are eight children born in the *** DEPARTAMENTO DE SAN JOSE *** between 1879 and 1898: MARIA ADELINA (1879), ZELMIRA CARLOTA (1880), ALBERTO JULIAN (1883), CARLOS AMBROSIO FLORENCIO (bapt. 1889), MARIA CONSUELO (1892), MARIA ANTONIETA (1894), ANGEL MIGUEL AVELINO (1898) and MARIA INES, who died at Montevideo in 1922. *** ZELMIRA WAS ALREADY IN THIS REGISTER, entered on 14 September and written off as 'NOT ours'. *** She is his daughter. *** THREE OF THE EIGHT CARRY NAMES OUT OF THE HOUSEHOLD AT THE AGUADA *** - his sister Maria Adelina, his brother Carlos Ambrosio, and his father Avelino. That is corroboration and not evidence; the evidence is the death registration. *** All eight are INDEX-LEVEL. ***  *** THE IMAGE WAS OPENED THE SAME DAY IT WAS CALLED AN ERRAND, and the weak link is now PRIMARY. *** Act No. 246, film 008165205 image 01604. He died at *** six in the morning of 1 March 1921, at the calle JUAN PAULLIER, Montevideo ***, and the act gives him as *** 'de nacionalidad ORIENTAL, NACIDO EN MONTEVIDEO, de SESENTA Y NUEVE ANOS de edad, de estado casado, de profesion RENTISTA, a consecuencia de CARCINOMA DE LA VEJIGA, segun consta del certificado del Dr. LUSSICH' ***, and then: *** 'Que el finado era hijo de AVELINO LERENA, fallecido, y de AMBROSIA TREIBEL, fallecida.' *** *** BORN AT MONTEVIDEO - which is where Pedro Alberto Ysabelino was baptised, at the Aguada, and NOT where his own children were born. *** The declarants were not family: JUAN MIRAMONTE, fifty, of 18 de Julio, and PEDRO FERNANDEZ, forty-eight, of Cerrito 230. *** AND THE ACT COUNTS HIS CHILDREN: 'era casado con Maria Ines Larriera, de cuya union quedan NUEVE HIJOS llamados: Maria Adelina, Zelmira, ELEIZA, Alberto, Carlos, Maria Ines, Maria Consuelo, Maria Antonieta y Miguel Avelino.' *** Eight of the nine were already found in the civil index; *** the third is a daughter no index here has matched, and her name is not securely read *** - ELEIZA or ELOIZA. *** The age of 69 is fifteen days early against a birth of 16 March 1852, which is what an age given by two neighbours looks like. *** RENTISTA is a fact about this branch nothing else here records: by 1921 it lived on property income.

name: Alfredo Justiniano LERENA Traibel
source: Catedral Basilica de Montevideo, marriage of 3 Feb 1892 - FULL-TEXT TRANSCRIPT READ; ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-R32C-K; and his own baptism, San Francisco de Asis, 12 Mar 1858 - ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-NRM4
note: *** A SON OF AVELINO LERENA AND AMBROSIA TRAIBEL, and a brother of Josefa - found 14 September 2026. *** Married HERMENEGILDA CAROLINA GAVARRO at the Catedral Basilica de Montevideo on 3 February 1892, aged thirty-five. *** THE MARRIAGE NEEDED A DISPENSATION FOR CONSANGUINITY - third degree with atingencia to the second - granted personally by MARIANO SOLER, the first Archbishop of Montevideo. *** He is written GERENA in his own marriage act while his father is written LORENA in the same sentence: a seventh spelling for this family. *** HIS BAPTISM IS FOUND: 12 March 1858, San Francisco de Asis, with his sister Ana Rosario. *** It gives his full name ALFREDO JUSTINIANO and his grandparents Sancho Lerena and Maria Fernandez. *** AND IT RESOLVES A PUZZLE: the JUSTINIANO looked like an echo of Justiniana Lenguas, who married into the other branch - a tidy connection that would have been wrong. He is named for his GODFATHER, JUSTINIANO LAVALLEJA, on the same line of the same act. *** This row used to end: "His baptismal age of 1858 sits oddly against the 35 he gave at his 1892 marriage, which would imply 1857; ages at marriage are the weakest date in genealogy." *** THE ODDNESS WAS THIS ARCHIVE'S, NOT THE RECORD'S - 20 September 2026. *** He was not born in 1858. The act read here on 14 September says so outright, and the sentence was never lifted off the page: *** "que nacio el dia DOS de OCTUBRE ... cincuenta y seis" *** - born *** 2 OCTOBER 1856 ***, and baptised at seventeen months. *** AND THAT MAKES THE MARRIAGE AGE EXACT. *** On 3 February 1892 a man born 2 October 1856 is thirty-five, which is precisely what he told the priest. The record and the age never disagreed; this register had written the baptism date into the birth column and then blamed the discrepancy on the record. *** Re-read off the image 20 September: *** film 007713686 image 2847, which also confirms the paternal grandparents "Don Sancho Lerena y Dona Maria Fernandez", the maternal "Don Juan Traibel y Dona Ysabel Centeno", and the godparents Justiniano Lavalleja and Dona Polonia Traibel.  *** HIS WIFE'S SURNAME WAS WRONG HERE FOR A WEEK, AND IS CORRECTED OFF THE IMAGE: SHE IS A GAVAZZO, NOT A GAVARRO, and her mother a SUAREZ, not a Juarez. *** The 1892 act was held from a machine full-text transcript; the image was opened on 21 September 2026 and reads 'hija legitima de Don GERONIMO GAVAZZO y Dona CAROLINA SUAREZ'. The same image confirms what this row already said - 'Don ALFREDO LERENA, soltero, de TREINTA Y CINCO anos de edad'. *** AND THE END OF HIS LIFE HAS A CEILING AT LAST. *** Hermenegilda died at Montevideo on 20 June 1940 *** 'de estado VIUDA' ***, so *** he died between February 1892 and June 1940 ***, aged somewhere between thirty-five and eighty-three. No death record for him has been found.

note: *** A FIDEL LERENA WITH A WIFE AND A GRANDSON, named on a Montevideo death registration of 1889. *** *** "Abuelos paternos FIDEL LERENA y MARIA RUEDAS" *** - the paternal grandparents of Victor Lerena, who died that year at twenty-eight. *** FIDEL is a rare forename in this family and appears exactly once elsewhere: Sancho Llerena's son, born about 1799. *** And this archive worked out only yesterday where that name came from - Don Fidel Rey of Montevideo, godfather at Agustina's baptism in 1795. *** WHETHER THIS FIDEL IS SANCHO'S SON IS NOT ESTABLISHED. *** Sancho's Fidel was born about 1799 and the Geneanet trees give him a death in 1822, at twenty-two or twenty-three. *** For this to be the same man, Pedro would have to be born by 1822 and fathering Victor at about forty. *** That is tight but possible, and the tree's 1822 is tree-only and has never been tested against a Montevideo burial. *** The alternative is a second Fidel Lerena at Montevideo, which nothing rules out. *** *** Recorded as a branch to test, not as a descent. *** This row said "THE TEST IS CHEAP AND HAS NOT BEEN RUN: a Montevideo marriage of FIDEL LERENA to MARIA RUEDAS, and a burial for Fidel around 1822." *** IT WAS RUN ON 20 SEPTEMBER 2026 AND BOTH HALVES CAME BACK EMPTY. *** No marriage of a Fidel Lerena to a Maria Rueda or Ruedas is indexed for Uruguay - control: the same query shape on Luis and Juanico returns the marriage act of 19 December 1864 as its first result. And no burial of a Fidel Lerena between 1815 and 1840 - control: Rodriguez in that window returns 62,026 records with real burials, so the shelf is not empty. *** THE SURPRISE IS WHICH WAY IT CUTS. *** The tree death of 1822 was the one thing that would have kept this Fidel apart from Sancho's son, and *** it is not in the record either ***. The two are still NOT merged - an unevidenced death is not evidence of survival - but nothing now separates them except the silence. See data/fs-session-2026-09-20.tsv. *** THE GRANDSON'S DATES ARE NOW EXACT, 20 September 2026: *** Victor Lerena, born *** 1861 *** at Montevideo, died *** 10 October 1889 *** - so the "twenty-eight" this row has carried is right to the year. His father is indexed *** PEDRO LORENA ***, which is the spelling the register already holds for him. The test that would settle Fidel himself was attempted on 20 September and could not be run - the API reached for it does not filter on a spouse surname. See data/fs-session-2026-09-20.tsv.

name: Mauricio LERENA (of Colla/Rosario, m. Casimira Montano 1837)

One is explicit: *** CIPRIANO LERENA MONTANA ***, whose 1928 death registration at Flores names both parents, and who is now in this register. *** FOUR MORE ARE CANDIDATES AND ARE NOT ENTERED: *** Manuel Lerena Montana (m. 20 April 1882, San Jose, b.1856), Ignacia Lerena (m. 27 April 1882, Trinidad, b.1864), Clara Lerena de Pallares (d. 3 March 1925, b.1848) and Ignacia Serena Leren de Dolz (d. 12 March 1921, b.1865). *** They match on the pair query but their own entries do not name the parents, *** and this archive does not enter a child on a query shape alone. name: Avelino Eduardo LERENA Traibel
source: Uruguay, registros parroquiales 1726-2000 - christening of Avelino Pedro Joaquin Silvestre, Union, Montevideo, 5 Mar 1866, ark 1:1:6D7Z-JGH2; and of Pedro Gualberto, Cordon, Montevideo, 15 Jan 1870; index read 20 September 2026
note: *** A FORK THIS ARCHIVE REFUSED TO CHOOSE IS NOW DECIDED, 20 September 2026. *** On 16 September a working log found a branch indexed *** LERENA VILLADEMOROS *** and set out two readings without picking one: either *** Avelino Lerena Fernandez (b.1815) married twice ***, Ambrosia Traibel and then Celedonia Villademoros, *** or Avelino Eduardo is a SON of his. *** It is the son. Two separate parish acts give this man's own father as *** AVELINO SERENA/LERENA *** with *** AMBROSIA TRAIBEL *** named on the record - so he is a child of that marriage, and the Villademoros children are Sancho's great-grandchildren. *** HE IS THEREFORE A NEW CHILD OF AVELINO AND AMBROSIA, *** beside Alejandro, Josefa, Ana Rosario, Alfredo Justiniano and Mercedes. He married *** CELEDONIA VILLADEMOROS ***, daughter of Pedro Villademoros and Angelica Mendez. *** INDEX-LEVEL: *** both acts are machine-indexed and neither image has been opened here. *** AND THE TEST NAMED ABOVE WAS RUN THE SAME EVENING AND CAME BACK EMPTY. *** LERENA with spouse surname VILLADEMOROS, Uruguay: 6,352 records, and *** not one of them is a marriage act. *** Every hit is a parent entry on somebody else's baptism or civil registration. *** The control is the one that worked two hours earlier: *** the same query shape on LERENA with spouse JUANICO puts the marriage act of 19 December 1864 at RANK ONE. So the shape finds a marriage when there is one to find. *** NEITHER VILLADEMOROS MARRIAGE IS IN THE INDEXED RECORD, *** and the brothers-and-sisters reading stays an inference. It would be settled by the parish marriage books of the Cordon and Union, which have not been walked.  *** AND HE HAS MORE CHILDREN THAN THIS ARCHIVE COULD SEE, FOUND 21 September 2026 BY DELETING A SEARCH PARAMETER. *** A parent-pair query on him with CELEDONIA VILLADEMOROS returns *** ZERO ***. Dropping the mother's SURNAME and keeping only 'Celedonia' returns *** SEVEN *** - including the two christenings this archive already held, which is how the zero was known to be false. The seven add: *** PEDRO SEGUNDO LERENA VILLADEMOROS, who died at Montevideo on 23 August 1936 aged 66, certificate 150, married to PAULINA PRANDO ALGAR ***; *** an AVELINO LERENA who died at Montevideo on 5 January 1914 aged 45, certificate 9, married to CARMEN LORENTE ***, whose mother is written CELEDONIA VILLADEMORO without the s; and marriage registrations of 1921 for both Avelino Pedro Joaquin Silvestre and Pedro Gualberto. *** WHETHER THAT IS FOUR CHILDREN OR TWO IS NOT SETTLED AND IS NOT GUESSED HERE. *** Pedro Segundo's estimated 1870 sits on Pedro Gualberto's birth of 19 October 1869; the 1914 Avelino's estimated 1869 sits four years off Avelino Pedro Joaquin Silvestre's December 1865 - and a man who died in 1914 cannot register a marriage in 1921. *** The ages come from death certificates and are the weakest field there is. *** TEST: the two 1921 marriage registrations, which would show which of these men were alive to marry.

name: Alejandro LERENA (m. Elisa VILLARDEMOROS)
source: Uruguay, registros parroquiales 1726-2000 - christening of Alejandro Joaquin Narciso Lerena, Cordon, Montevideo, 29 May 1873; ark 1:1:6D3Z-WTXR; index read 20 September 2026

In the same decade *** AVELINO EDUARDO LERENA *** - documented as a son of Avelino Lerena and Ambrosia Traibel - married *** CELEDONIA VILLADEMOROS ***. *** THREE THINGS TIE THE TWO BAPTISMS TOGETHER: *** the surname on both mothers; a *** JOAQUIN *** standing godfather at each, indexed "Joaquin Requena" on one and "Joaquin Regusa y Garcia" on the other, which is one name and one machine mangling it; and the godmother here is *** ANGELICA VILLADEMOROS ***, while Celedonia's mother is ANGELICA MENDEZ - a daughter named for her. *** THE INFERENCE: two Lerena brothers married two Villademoros sisters, *** which is the same shape as the two Lerena siblings who married two Cardozo siblings and produced the 1911 dispensation. *** WHAT IS NOT DOCUMENTED: *** this act does NOT name his own parents, so he is NOT joined to Alejandro Lerena Traibel here, though the age fits - that man was born 1843 or 1845 and would be twenty-seven or twenty-nine. *** THE TEST: *** the two marriage acts, or any record naming this Alejandro's father. *** AND THE TEST NAMED ABOVE WAS RUN THE SAME EVENING AND CAME BACK EMPTY. *** LERENA with spouse surname VILLADEMOROS, Uruguay: 6,352 records, and *** not one of them is a marriage act. *** Every hit is a parent entry on somebody else's baptism or civil registration. *** The control is the one that worked two hours earlier: *** the same query shape on LERENA with spouse JUANICO puts the marriage act of 19 December 1864 at RANK ONE. So the shape finds a marriage when there is one to find. *** NEITHER VILLADEMOROS MARRIAGE IS IN THE INDEXED RECORD, *** and the brothers-and-sisters reading stays an inference. It would be settled by the parish marriage books of the Cordon and Union, which have not been walked.  *** THE NULL PUBLISHED AGAINST THIS ROW RESTS ON A CONTROL THAT DID NOT CONTROL FOR THE RIGHT RISK - noted 21 September 2026, and the null is NOT withdrawn. *** The finding was that LERENA with spouse surname VILLADEMOROS returns 6,352 records and not one marriage act, controlled by LERENA with spouse JUANICO, which put the 1864 marriage at rank one. *** JUANICO HAS ONE SPELLING AND VILLADEMOROS HAS AT LEAST THREE. *** This register already holds VILLADEMOROS, VILLARDEMOROS and, from a death registration read today, VILLADEMORO. And on the same day a parent-pair query on this surname returned a ZERO that a single deleted parameter turned into SEVEN. *** So the control proved the query SHAPE works; it did not prove that this SURNAME is reachable through it. *** The two marriage acts may be absent from the index, or they may be present under a spelling nobody asked for. Until the Cordon and Union marriage books are walked, the difference is not known - and that is a weaker claim than the one this archive published.
